idea: Colors & shapes – colors #1 (THE SUPERMARKET, fruit aisle): a shiny red apple rolls off the fruit crate and bounces right up to Baby Ava's face ('Wow! Look! A red apple!'); chorus 'Colors, colors! Red, yellow, green!'; she shows one fruit per color – 'Red, red, red! A red apple! Yum!', 'Yellow, yellow! A yellow banana!', 'Green, green, green! A green pear!'; copy-me 'Point with me! Red! Yellow! Green!'; she asks the viewer 'Which one is yellow? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The banana! Yellow! Yay!'; lesson 'Colors everywhere I go!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now apple, banana and pear in a neat row on the crate, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Red Apple! 🍎 Learn Colors with Baby Ava | Red, Yellow, Green | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A shiny red apple bounces right up to Baby Ava at the supermarket! 🍎 Sing along as Ava learns her colors with a red apple, a yellow banana and a green pear.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A red apple!" – a surprise at the fruit crate
🎵 Colors, colors! Red, yellow, green!
🍎 Red, red, red! A red apple! Yum!
🍌 Yellow, yellow! A yellow banana!
🍐 Green, green, green! A green pear!
👉 Point with Ava: red, yellow, green!
🤔 "Which one is yellow?" – can you answer?
👋 Colors everywhere! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: colors red, yellow and green • English words: apple, banana, pear • finding colors all around us

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along colors cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Ava finding red, yellow and green fruit at the supermarket.
